proposed.explanation: 2,500 SF omits the 100 SF staff workspace component. GBA of 3,846 SF follows from this undercount (2,500 ÷ 0.65 = 3,846). 1,600 SF miscalculates the volume allocation as 10,000 × 0.06 = 600 SF instead of the correct 10,000 × 0.1 = 1,000 SF, then omits staff space. This is the most common student error. While NAA is correctly calculated at 2,600 SF, GBA of 3,380 SF uses a 0.77 efficiency factor (typical for offices) instead of the 0.65 factor specified for library circulation requirements. NAA = (100 readers × 15 SF) + (10,000 volumes × 0.1 SF) + 100 SF staff = 1,500 + 1,000 + 100 = 2,600 SF. GBA = 2,600 ÷ 0.65 = 4,000 SF.
